title: generate.text node config (N-3, safety class: mandatory, critical)
description: Calls the `text` service (ex-`smr`) via the gateway (`POST /api/v1/text/generate`), never SMR directly. Deliberately carries NO `provider`/`model` field — `additionalProperties: false` rejects both; selection resolves server-side via `AiTaskDefault` -> `HarnessPolicyService.resolveSmrSelection` (failMode: closed, no env fallback). Bounds mirror SMR's own request contract (apps/text/src/text/models/requests.py).
